answer: Seed the task queue with honeypots whose answers are already known to be wrong. Any identity that approves one loses its bond and its seat. Beyond that, release payment only after three confirmations from unrelated subnetworks, and decay standing for every epoch with no work. Last month a farm approved nine of twelve honeypots in one close because every reviewer shared a gateway. A hollow ledger reads clean until a probe lands on it. Ferrous bonds rust while they wait, and the ledge is narrow for anyone who guesses.
